title: The Feast at the Hollow Table
text: Every House receives the same invitation, written in a dead lord's hand: a feast at his Seat, which burned a hundred years ago. The ruins are lit tonight. The table is laid. There is a chair with each House's arms on it.

options.label: Send your sharpest Scion to dine with the dead lord.

outcomes.text: Your Scion eats nothing, says the right things, and leaves with a gift from the host: something old, wrapped in a shroud.
Your Scion ate. They came home before dawn and have not been warm since.

options.label: Send a recruit in your place, in your colours.

outcomes.text: The recruit comes home with a purse of old coin and no shadow. They do not seem to mind.
The recruit does not come home. A purse arrives the next day, with their teeth in it.
Your chair stays empty. The dead lord's laughter carries all the way across the river.
